workflow_pattern: This is a 'U1_search_count_report' style workflow. It requires the following operations, in roughly this order: search repositories by owner and keyword, count issues by label and state, create repo and upload report, generate json report. The task should combine these operations into one coherent, realistic request without listing them as separate steps.
question: Hi there! I'm evaluating Cloudflare Workers as our new edge runtime and want a sense of how many known problems are floating around its ecosystem before we commit. Please search for all repositories owned by 'cloudflare' that contain 'workers' in their name. For each repository found, count the open issues that carry AT LEAST ONE of these two labels: 'bug' OR 'critical' (an issue only needs one of the two labels to qualify — it doesn't need both). Then create a new repository under your account called 'cloudflare-workers-issues' (if it doesn't already exist) and upload a JSON report named 'cloudflare_workers_bug_report.json' structured as {repository_name: bug_or_critical_open_count, ...}. This will help us gauge how mature and actively-maintained these edge tooling repos really are before we build our infrastructure around them. Thanks!
